Tala (Design): uploaded a new prototype for the prompt-sets review table. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/compact-review-table?node-id=3:1 Tala (Design): idea: compact table rows (single column) with a left sticky prompt excerpt, center diff column with a tiny token-heatmap pill, right action cluster. rows expandable inline. aiming for fast triage flows for reviewers. Ben (Product): looks promising. two questions: how do we make bulk "validate" explicit and reversible? and how do we show small regressions without causing alarm? Tala (Design): thinking action label "Mark as validated" for clarity. bulk button would say "Mark selected as validated". show small chevrons + % for magnitude; avoid red when it's a tiny change. maybe call small drops a "quality dip"? Maya (QA): prefer "validated" language for final sign-off. for minor regressions we should show a subtle warning icon not a scary badge. also add quick access to the baseline comparison inline. Iris (Frontend): perf note 0: use variable row heights with virtualization; expanding a row should measure and update the list. will add keyboard navigation: up/down to move, Enter to expand, V to validate (shortcut). Omar (Accessibility): accessibility: each row must be semantic (button or link) with aria-expanded. action icons must be buttons with aria-labels. token-heatmap needs text alternative, e.g., aria-label="tokens changed 3%". also ensure focus order is logical with sticky toolbar. review-bot: CI/axe results from branch feat/compact-table: ``` axe: color-contrast (TokenHeatmap) contrast 2.1:1 against white eslint: jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions in RowSummary ``` Iris (Frontend): I'll darken the heatmap palette and wrap the summary in a
[heatmap]
``` Iris (Frontend): will add focus-visible outlines and a skip link to results for keyboard users. Tala (Design): alternative phrasing proposals: "quality dip", "minor quality change", "small regression". avoid alarmist words. Ben prefers "quality dip". Maya (QA): agree with less alarmist phrasing, but ensure severity chips exist (High/Med/Low) and are filterable. Omar (Accessibility): filters need keyboard support and ARIA role="listbox" options. provide clear labels for severity. review-bot: reminder: add axe baseline for /prompt-sets in CI to catch regressions. Ben (Product): thanks all. Tala will post updated frames in Figma with darker heatmap, updated copy, and toast spec. Iris will fix the CI issues and attach a short keyboard-nav screencap to the PR. leaving thread open for last accessibility or copy nits. :white_check_mark:
